description:
Restore a transferred backup (`sql_gz` + optional `filestore_tgz`, absolute paths
    already on `host`) into the PROD database - the final data step of a migration. Makes
    **odoo the owner** of every restored object so later module updates don't hit
    'permission denied' (a plain restore-as-postgres does). `replace=True` first drops an
    existing db of that name (e.g. the empty one Odoo auto-creates on first start) - this
    is destructive, so it needs confirm=True AND replace=True together. dry_run shows the
    exact script (no ssh). Returns the restored table count + whether Odoo came back up.
name: restore_to_prod
